title: runners.md says no other project's jobs run on this host, but the docker-windows runner is also enabled for another project
goal: kb/_self/runners.md says what locking does: it stops a runner being added to more projects; the docker-windows runner is also enabled for another of the operator's projects (so that project's jobs naming its tags run on this host), and the docker-linux one only for this project.
